description: This file defines the WaypointCircuit class used within Unity to manage a series of waypoints for path following or routing, including methods for retrieving route positions, smoothing routes, and visualization in the editor. It also contains related nested classes for waypoint list management and custom inspector drawer for Unity Editor.

classes.name: WaypointCircuit
classes.description: Main class managing waypoint paths, including route calculations, caching, and gizmo visualization.

methods.name: GetRoutePoint
methods.description: Returns a RoutePoint (position and direction) at a given distance along the route.

methods.name: GetRoutePosition
methods.description: Calculates the position along the route at a specified distance, with optional smoothing.

methods.name: CatmullRom
methods.description: Performs Catmull-Rom spline interpolation between points.

methods.name: CachePositionsAndDistances
methods.description: Precomputes waypoint positions and cumulative distances for efficient lookup.

methods.name: OnDrawGizmos
methods.description: Draws route visualization gizmos when not selected.

methods.name: OnDrawGizmosSelected
methods.description: Draws route visualization gizmos when selected.

methods.name: DrawGizmos
methods.description: Handles actual gizmo drawing for route visualization.

nested_classes.name: RoutePoint
nested_classes.description: Struct representing a position and direction along the route.

classes.name: UnityStandardAssets.Utility.Inspector.WaypointListDrawer
classes.description: Custom Unity Editor PropertyDrawer for waypoint list management.
